messages:
Maria CS: Hey team :wave: Novaterra (trial) needs a temporary APAC/Japan allowlist + QPS bump for an investor demo next Tue 09:00 JST. Renewal risk flagged if demo underperforms — they asked for 50 qps sustained for 2 hours. Can we do a scoped lift and auto-revoke?

Ashok Ops: @Maria can you share source IPs and whether this is just egress to our edge or needs regional routing? Also what org id / project?

Maria CS: Org: novaterra-prod (customer-id: NVT-81). IPs below, TTL request until 2026-04-15 12:00 UTC. Only for /v1/generate and embeddings. IPs:

```
203.0.113.45/32
203.0.113.46/32
2001:db8:abcd::/64
```

Ashok Ops: Got it. I will open an ops ticket and whitelist those CIDRs on ap-northeast-1 edge. Creating now...

ops-bot: Ticket #CS-4821 created: allowlist + qps bump (assignee: Ashok). ETA 3 hours. https://redwood.ops/tickets/CS-4821

Samira Eng: Heads-up — 50 qps sustained for 2 hours should be fine on Dedicated pool; hosted shared may need rate shaping. What's their current concurrency pattern? Any big prompt lengths?

Maria CS: Mostly short prompts (avg 120 tokens). Peak tokens ~25k total over window. They're on hosted API (paid) — requested hosted exception.

Kevin SE: For hosted exception we'll set route policy to ap-northeast-1 with model fallback to a smaller variant if saturated. Recommend pinning to `rwd-medium-1` for demo to keep latencies predictable. Need infra approval to bump soft qps limit to 60 for that org.

Ashok Ops: Approved. Setting soft_qps to 60 with hard cap 80. Will apply IP allowlist to org NVT-81 and set auto-revoke at 2026-04-15T12:00Z. Adding note to ticket.

Maria CS: Amazing, thank you :white_check_mark: Please confirm once live so I can update the customer and record the renewal touchpoint.

ops-bot: CS-4821 updated: allowlist applied, soft_qps=60, hard_qps=80, auto-revoke=2026-04-15T12:00Z. Assigned to Ashok. ETA ~15m.

Ashok Ops: Done — please sanity-check, @Maria. Also pushed a short playbook entry:

```
If customer demo: temp allowlist -> soft_qps bump -> monitor token/latency -> auto-revoke.
```

Maria CS: Verified from customer side, they can see responses. I'll follow up on renewal cadence after demo. Thanks everyone!
